title: Silent Bandstand Revival Dilemma
setting: The sun-warmed cobblestones of Willow Creek’s town square frame a weathered bandstand, silent for exactly five years after the town’s marching band disbanded. Moss clings to its wooden support beams, and a crumpled 2019 concert poster tacks to one side, half-torn by wind. The square’s only regular visitors are skateboarders and a stray tabby cat that naps on the stage steps.

characters.name: Kael
characters.tendencies: He counts every leftover relic of Willow Creek’s past to preserve fading local traditions.

characters.name: Lila
characters.tendencies: She shares stories of the old marching band at the square to rally community support for a revival.

characters.name: Jax
characters.tendencies: He learns restoration work from a retired handyman to fix the bandstand’s broken wood and rusted fixtures.
